page.overview:
Who is Carlov?

If these requirements are met, will ask to wait an entire day, in which that time he will spend making a out of the subject in the .

In , he will work on a maximum of 12 at once as opposed to the previous limit of a single at a time. The is also equipped with a new feature that will place a golden icon on that meet 's requirements to be turned into a . Thus does not have to return to the to receive 's approval.

Once the is completed, leaves to find inspiration elsewhere, leaving as the 's new master.
